title: Personal CRM & Networking Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Monica contacts (`monica:contact`), Clay relationships (`clay:relationship`), LinkedIn connections (`linkedin:connection`), follow-up reminders (`followup:reminder`), and intro requests (`intro:request`).
app: Monica contact relationship logs, Clay network exports, LinkedIn connection events, follow-up reminder tasks, and warm-intro request trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=followup:reminder) OR (index=personal sourcetype=monica:contact)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="followup:reminder","primary",sourcetype="monica:contact","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from followup:reminder and monica:contact to see whether two personal crm feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `followup:reminder` and `monica:contact` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main personal crm data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
